## The sequence

| # | Spoonful | What it says | The one ask | When |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Where we are after 14 October | Jonathan testified; cross went only to what he saw himself; the case rests on the class limit in the SPA; nothing is filed before 4 November; Shirley De Leon is next. | A thirty-minute meeting this week; confirm De Leon for 4 Nov. | Now |
| 2 | Our summary judgment motion, on paper | The April motion has no ruling in the orders we hold. Ask whether the pre-trial order resolved it; if not, file a motion to resolve with the alternative prayer under Rule 35 §4 for an order specifying the facts without substantial controversy (Annex "A": our narrative, sixteen facts from the record). Draft attached. | His answer on the pre-trial order; his changes to the draft. | After 1 is answered; by 24 Oct |
| 3 | My mother testifies on rebuttal, by videoconference | Why rebuttal; what she will say; her draft affidavit attached for his review; the two questions only he can answer (the once-only leave; how she testifies from California). | His answer on the leave question and the videoconference route. | After 2 is answered; by 28 Oct |
| 4 | The receipts do not add up | Their own Exhibit 5: ₱602,750 receipted against a ₱250,000 price; ₱219,000 after the deed that says "in hand paid"; "Full payment" in February 2017. One table, no theory. | Agree to ask Salvador, on cross in January, for the duplicate leaves and the booklets. | After 3; by 31 Oct |
| 5 | Completing Exhibits E and H | Our filed copies are short pages; the certified complete copies are in hand; they are offered on 9 December. | Agree to mark the complete copies at the offer. | After 4; by 7 Nov |
| 6 | Mrs. King on 11 November | Her affidavit as filed; her 2021 pleading comes in later as a certified record; the two things she must not be led into (20-6030, the perjury case). | Confirm her for 11 Nov; no supplemental affidavit. | After 5; by 6 Nov |
| 7 | The 9 December offer | The exhibit list with one-line purposes; rest "subject to rebuttal"; ask for rebuttal dates after 10 March and for memoranda. | Approve the list and the three sentences for the record. | After 6; by 27 Nov |
| 8 | The lead argument in one page | Article 1898 and the class limit, with the exhibit page for each fact; what we do not argue. | Confirm this is the memorandum's spine. | After 7; December |
| 9 | Cross of Salvador | The checklist, his papers only: the 2005 down payment, "in hand paid" against February 2017, the serial numbers, the 1991 power, the Agcaoili channel. | Adopt or amend the questions. | In person, early January |
| 10 | Cross of Princess and Erwin | Renters since 1975; the 2006 survey receipt; the 2020 Toronto power; the rents (our damages figure); no permit on file. | Adopt or amend. | In person, January |
| 11 | What we hold for rebuttal | The records gathered quietly and what each answers; shown, not sent. | Decide the rebuttal order and the subpoenas. | In person, after the defense rests |

If a second lawyer joins as collaborating counsel, spoonfuls 1 to 3 go to Atty. Barandon alone and the rest go to both. If the consultant route is taken, the feed to Atty. Barandon does not change.
